errors.evidence: The first label on the x-axis is "股份回购" (stock repurchase), not "股权回购" (equity repurchase). While the terms are similar, they are not identical, and the description should use the verbatim label from the chart.
The last category on the x-axis is "被约谈" (being summoned for a talk), not "被处罚" (being punished). The description incorrectly identifies this category.
The description assigns a value to the wrongly identified category "被处罚". This bar actually corresponds to the category "被约谈".
